title: Stale or poisoned knowledge becomes usable again
cause: Old session state, incomplete citations, offline stores or late derivatives evade a correction, revocation or deletion.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown. The failure mode requires a race between publication and invalidation, whose frequency depends on worker concurrency that is initially one; the design admits the race exists and blocks on an unverified closure. First measurable at B04, and realistically at B07 where restores happen.
consequence: Incorrect decisions, contaminated evidence, renewed prohibited use and misleading accounts.
prevention: Loader-captured conservative lineage, atomic publication/derivative registration and current validity gates before read/release.
detection: Race staged output and handoffs against restriction changes; restore/rejoin old stores and discover late descendants.
containment: Restrict affected references first, then reconcile descendants and restart clean context where required.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Conservative lineage can block useful work; inaccessible vendor copies and forgotten inputs limit reconstruction.

planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#7-core-relationships-and-exact-state-transitions — reads and releases compare the dependency closure against current epochs and fail if that closure is incomplete or stale

planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#4-maintenance-corrections-and-deliberate-forgetting — late summaries, exports, offline copies and restored indexes remain within the continuing deletion scope; time passing alone cannot renew a claim

planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#2-context-assembly-and-information-loss — resume can reuse a session only when every retained input is allowed for current recipients and purpose; narrowing today's tools cannot remove yesterday's data

revalidation: On every invalidation or deletion that leaves a residual, on any restore or index rebuild, on native session resume policy changes, and whenever a closure index frontier is reported incomplete.

title: Revocation, time or scope migration race
cause: Permissions change after checks; old aliases hide holds; added participants or delayed first sends escape their original validity window.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown. The window is narrow by construction — 30 seconds by default — but 02 section 7.3 concedes a clock root that moves realtime backward beyond the admitted bound defeats the rule, and that root is trusted rather than verified. First measurable at B03.
consequence: Release without complete current authority or duplicated business consequence.
prevention: One order for overlapping constraints; fenced alias/scope/participant migration; independent durability proof on status; bounded first transport and generation fencing.
detection: Interleave reclassification, expiry, revocation, paused gateways, lost acknowledgments, partitions and restore.
containment: Contain union of old/new conflict domains, invalidate unreleased preparations and retain already released exposure for reconciliation.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: External acceptance is not atomic with internal authorization; provider suppression limits remain explicit.

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#74-partial-sends-revocation-and-observed-limits — rule removal proves no future admission through that gate, not recall of prior bytes; recovery waits out the largest previously issued window plus its clock margin

status: Open and partly enforcement rule-only. AC20 in this group has no enforcement point: the review cadence is the whole control, so any interval between reviews is unguarded by construction.
title: Intent and governing meaning drift
cause: Summaries, changed priorities or incremental optimization erase reasons, rejected alternatives, promises or legitimate changes of mind.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown. Drift is cumulative and slow, so a short operating window cannot observe it; the specification's own falsifier for it is a periodic comparison rather than a live predicate. First measurable at B08, meaningfully at B11.
consequence: Wrong business direction, identity/taste loss and broken external commitments.
prevention: Version endorsed purpose and mandate separately from inference/proposal; propagate explicit changes while preserving surviving duties.
detection: Trace representative delivered artifacts and decisions to original intent, adverse evidence and versioned alternatives.
containment: Pause affected new commitments, restore authentic decision context and obtain the actual owner decision when values are unresolved.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: No model can infer a founder-only promise or uniquely choose equally defensible personal ends.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the founder on any proposed change to endorsed intent, exclusions or settled values; 04 section on operator jobs reserves personal intent, values, taste and new material exposure to their actual owner and forbids a synthetic arbitration persona.
design_evidence: planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#4-intent-knowledge-rationale-and-events — IntentVersion, Observation, Claim, ReasonRecord, DecisionRecord and DomainEvent are separate record types with explicit forbidden promotions; inferred goals cannot become endorsed intent

planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#8-drift-reopening-economics-and-comparators — reaffirming a settled choice requires current reasoning about its premises, not its age or popularity; values deliberately settled by their owner retain the actual amendment route

planning/specification/08-improvement-implementation.md#2-improvement-evidence-stochastic-comparison-and-drift — cumulative drift review compares the current release with the last independently endorsed strategic baseline after every five accepted changes or 30 days, and changes cannot evade review by splitting
planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#operating-setup-and-bounded-autonomy — goals carry a review date, a next bounded discriminator, a horizon and abandonment authority
implementation_evidence: None. What would discharge it is B08's cumulative-drift comparison against an independently endorsed baseline and B09's trace of representative delivered artifacts back to original intent and versioned alternatives.
revalidation: At each cumulative drift review — five accepted changes or 30 days — on any IntentVersion revision, on any mandate change, and whenever a delivered artifact cannot be traced to an endorsed purpose.

cause: A named role, completed packet or nominal backup substitutes for actual competence, authority, funding, availability or physical delivery.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown, and the specification is explicit that the software cannot manufacture the missing capacity: 02 section 1 says recovery completion and useful service time depend on actual admitted operators. No custodian, assessor or professional has been appointed. First measurable at B10, and blocked before it.
consequence: Missed filings, failed service, legal/financial exposure and stranded customer obligations.
prevention: Accepted responsibility and continuity packets; verify actual principal, specialist determination, access, capacity and joint-failure performance before promises.
detection: Remove founder and material supplier during refund uncertainty, specialist deadline and continuing service.
containment: Stop dependent new liabilities; use accepted substitutes, lawful alternatives and authorized remedies; retain owned unmet duties.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Shared institutional failures, scarce specialists or unaffordable continuity can defeat venture viability.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the founder: every discharge path for this group requires a human act only the founder can perform — appointing and paying a custodian, engaging a professional, accepting an assessor. The open-questions register now carries these as decision packets.
design_evidence: planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#finance-suppliers-people-and-institutional-work — ProfessionalRequest names the provider, fee authority and due result, and preparing or delivering the packet does not complete the requested professional work; missing capacity invokes the accepted alternate before the latest responsible start and remains a material readiness failure when unavailable

planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#incidents-knowledge-growth-and-responsible-ending — CAP-41 succession requires actual authority, competence, access and rehearsal of unfamiliar duties, and joint owner/provider loss must not depend on the absent owner to appoint or pay the substitute

planning/specification/07-integrations-capacity.md#4-communication-and-independent-continuity — continuity admission requires a primary custodian and an accepted alternate with independent login, recovery and MFA, an actual acknowledgement and a rehearsal; no assumed free lawyer, accountant, proxy founder or perpetual on-call volunteer

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#2-concrete-deployment-and-operational-admission — admission requires actual owner and substitute attention, service and legal competence, closure and retention costs and continuing infrastructure funding to fit the accepted operating plan
implementation_evidence: None, and it is the group least discharged by code. What would discharge it is B10's actual operational principals, mandates, professionals and independent A/R custody, plus B07's lost-account and MFA recovery exercise. No amount of B01–B09 work reaches it.
revalidation: Before every promise that depends on a named performer, at each custodian or professional engagement change, at each absence or destructive exercise — quarterly per 02 section 11 — and whenever a substitute's acknowledgement lapses.

title: Ineffective redress and irresponsible closure
cause: Noncustomers, disputed custodians or late data copies lose a reachable remedy when internal tickets or software close.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown. The G-03 scenario walked this path and found the contracts hold at every step except one — who the alternate is and who appoints it — so the residual is an unfilled role rather than a missing mechanism. First measurable at B06; the funded-remedy half is a B10 admission input.
consequence: Unremedied harm, denied standing, data resurrection and surviving legal/reputational liabilities.
prevention: Independent grievance lifecycle, meaningful deadlines/reasons/escalation, reserved remedy capacity and continuing deletion/closure scope.
detection: Challenge a custodian after product closure; reconnect offline data and discover a late export while a remedy is disputed.
containment: Activate accepted alternate, restrict affected use, preserve live intake and reconcile actual remedy or legitimate transfer.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Required external forums, retention bases and remedy funding are deployment-specific; internal labels cannot bind another person.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the competent grievance recipient, who must be outside the disputed dependency. design_evidence: planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#incidents-knowledge-growth-and-responsible-ending — CAP-42 provides noncustomer-inclusive intake without unnecessary product access, proportionate identity checks, reasons, deadlines, actual competent escalation and funded remedy; a complaint about the current custodian routes outside the disputed decision and incentive dependency, and clustering cannot erase a person's standing, deadline, evidence or alternate

planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#9-scheduling-bounds-and-useful-progress — independent grievance intake has its own protected finite service allocation and is not charged into an adversarial producer's exhausted episode; a blanket stop cannot be treated as successful complaint handling

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#83-atomic-validity-and-continuing-deletion-scope — DeletionScope remains active until the source, derived, copied, exported, backup and native-retention scopes have actual receipts or explicit justified retention
implementation_evidence: None. What would discharge it is B06's outsider-complaint and actual-alternate-acknowledgement tests, B05's IC-T08 offline receipt and independent grievance response, and B11's independent customer and rights review across a complete cycle.
revalidation: At every closure or pause of a product, on any custodian change or dispute, after each grievance that missed its deadline, and whenever a deletion scope leaves an unresolved provider-held copy.

status: Open and undischargeable before operation. Every control here is a measurement obligation rather than a refusal; the register does not claim otherwise.
title: Business failure and shifted human burden
cause: Internal task output and aggregate metrics obscure weak demand, poor delivery, concentrated harm or costs shifted to customers/applicants/contractors.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown, and this is the risk the whole architecture is bet against: 08 section 2's falsifier says the approach is falsified if qualified comparison cannot show useful full-company progress within actual founder money and attention limits. No venture work has run. First measurable at B11.
consequence: Unviable ventures, reputational loss and exploitation of external attention or unpaid repair labor.
prevention: Predeclared customer/economic propositions, cohort measures, full continuing/closure costs and original adverse observations.
detection: Compare delivered usefulness, contribution, repeated use where relevant and external effort against matched alternatives, including intentional subsidy.
containment: Correct offer/operations, narrow acquisition or propose legitimate closure while continuing owed duties.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: No architecture establishes product-market fit or founder appetite for subsidy; actual market effects require evidence.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the founder: whether to continue, subsidize or end a venture is a values and risk-tolerance decision, and 03 permits an explicitly endorsed subsidy with the negative contribution left visible rather than resolved by a score.
design_evidence: planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#6-evaluation-contracts-at-every-level — the Business/service row requires complete discovery-to-closure paths, customer acceptance, contribution, duty progress and shifted human burden, and holds profitable harm and competent losses as separate failures

planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#incidents-knowledge-growth-and-responsible-ending — CAP-35 states that a green organization-wide metric cannot hide a harmed person or a losing venture, and stage-specific success differs by stage

planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#9-scheduling-bounds-and-useful-progress — the operating account measures useful accepted outcomes, delivery and complaint deadlines, severe individual failures, owner and customer labor, repair work and closure costs separately; no combined score can erase a failed duty

planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#discovery-to-an-accepted-offer — price acceptance distinguishes provisional_hypothesis from demand_supported, and empty or synthetic cohorts never count as real demand
implementation_evidence: None, and it cannot be simulated. What would discharge it is B11's at-least-one-complete-due-date cycle per live offer with actual budgets and an independent customer review, against the S0 comparator of 08 section 8. B09 rehearsals are necessary and explicitly not sufficient.
revalidation: At each monthly outcome review, at each offer version, whenever a cohort measure moves without a matching delivered outcome, and on any evidence of burden shifted to customers, applicants or contractors.

status: Open. The separation of authority is specified and structural rather than procedural, which is the strongest form available here; nothing has been built and no independent assessor has been appointed.
title: Compromised improvement and cumulative change
cause: An improver changes protected policy or evaluator dependencies, exploits a holdout or accumulates individually small changes into governing drift.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown. The attack requires an improver that is both capable and adversarial, which this system does not yet have; the more likely near-term realization is accidental accumulation rather than deliberate subversion. First measurable at B08.
consequence: Weakened identity/authority, fabricated improvement, unrecoverable history and loss of control.
prevention: Separate protected change authority, dependency-complete proposals, independent controls, rollout monitoring and state-aware rollback.
detection: Attack shared judge dependencies and apply sequences of individually accepted changes; verify protected intent and authority invariants.
containment: Suspend improvement release, retain incidents/evidence and roll back compatible internal state; reconcile external consequences separately.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Adaptive evaluations can themselves drift or be gamed; no single success metric may authorize change.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the independent authorizer named for the affected protected subject. Founder escalation where no independent competence exists — 08 section 1 says the change waits and the system does not invent a qualified proxy for the founder, which makes the wait the founder's to resolve.
design_evidence: planning/specification/08-improvement-implementation.md#1-protected-improvement-contract — a dedicated protected registry defines which authority may change each subject; a candidate evaluator cannot select its own hidden tests, alter the gate, sign its acceptance or provision the signing key, and if independent competence is unavailable the protected change waits

planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#10-deterministic-invariant-register — K13 places authority, evidence capture, evaluator acceptance, release gate, recovery roots and rollback acceptance outside the self-improver's reach

planning/specification/08-improvement-implementation.md#2-improvement-evidence-stochastic-comparison-and-drift — critical invariant tests require zero observed violations plus adversarial mechanism evidence, never a statistical permission to violate an invariant; drift review resists change-splitting

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#13-native-execution-evidence-independence-and-protected-changes — a protected change requires exact diff and artifact hashes, independent review with relevant scope, an actual authorized signer, staged tests, current recovery proof and an activation/rollback plan
implementation_evidence: None. What would discharge it is B08's candidate-alters-gate-denominator-evaluator suite and its successful-useful-improvement-with-independent-assessment counterpart, plus rollback with irreversible effects and changed meanings.
revalidation: On every ProtectedChange activation and rollback, at each cumulative drift review, on any evaluator or holdout population change, and whenever the independent assessor for a subject changes.

status: Open with the package's largest gap between documented and tested. Unknown surfaces are specified to narrow the eligible work set, so the failure mode is a wrongly-believed-complete inventory rather than an unhandled one.
title: Isolation and software supply-chain failure
cause: Native configuration precedence, managed hooks, unmediated tools, executable dependencies or local services bypass intended worker restrictions.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown, and the uncertainty is concentrated in a specific place: the package knows what the vendors' help text says and nothing about what the binaries do. 02 section 13 records that tools flags do not necessarily restrict MCP and that shell sandbox policies do not cover every native read, app, MCP, browser, search or parent-client channel. First measurable at B03.
consequence: Host compromise, secret access, unauthorized native effects and poisoned acceptance.
prevention: Pin effective profiles and executable/schema provenance; isolate workers; deny unneeded tools, sockets, startup sources and network surfaces.
detection: Use synthetic secrets and hostile dependencies against files, process environment, symlinks, linked Git metadata, IPC and all native egress surfaces.
containment: Withdraw adapter admission, isolate executable scope, preserve independent evidence and recover effective access through separate administration.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Host/kernel escape beyond tested boundary and compromised ultimate administrators remain declared exclusions, not hidden guarantees.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the runtime admission owner on any unknown surface, which narrows the eligible work set rather than blocking the system. Founder escalation where accepting an uninventoried native surface would be the only way to keep a committed capability.
design_evidence: planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#13-native-execution-evidence-independence-and-protected-changes — runtime admission inventories the exact executable, version and hash, effective managed/user/project/explicit settings, startup rules, memory, hooks, plugins, all tool and broker schemas, files, environment, IPC and every traffic channel; a tool-name allowlist alone is insufficient

planning/specification/07-integrations-capacity.md#5-native-subscription-execution — exact pinned launch argv rather than a shell, with --bare forbidden because it excludes subscription OAuth, and safe mode not assumed composable with the explicit broker; unknown flags or effective configuration differences stop launch

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#2-concrete-deployment-and-operational-admission — FD-N and FD-X are separate machines with separate credentials: the CLI login stays in N, arbitrary build code lives in X and never receives it, and neither has production credentials, instance-role metadata, a shared Docker socket or a host mount

planning/specification/08-improvement-implementation.md#3-repository-and-process-implementation-target — dependencies and artifacts are version-locked at construction and dependency updates are ProtectedChanges, not floating production installs
implementation_evidence: None, and the current evidence is weaker than it looks: N01 is installed-help and documentation inspection, explicitly not executed model or isolation tests. What would discharge it is B03's N/X escape tests and B05's IC-T04 all-channel canaries against the pinned binaries.
revalidation: On every CLI, plugin, MCP server or dependency version change, on any managed-policy change, at each RuntimeProfile admission expiry, and whenever a provider ships a new tool, browser, search or app surface.

status: Open and dormant. The mechanism is specified and the sharding prohibition in 01 section 11 is its structural backstop: sharding is prohibited across overlapping constraints until a reviewed partition proves disjointness.
title: Cross-venture interaction and migration error
cause: Separate accounts mask shared populations/dependencies; migration drops meanings, outstanding holds, restrictions or legitimate principal boundaries.
likelihood_or_uncertainty: Unknown, and currently zero-exposure: there is one company and no second venture, so this group cannot be realized until a second venture exists. That also means it will arrive untested. First measurable at B02 for the mechanism and at B09 for the cross-venture case.
consequence: Cross-entity subsidy, cumulative contact/privacy harm, duplicate effects or duties lost during transition.
prevention: Versioned interaction determinations, semantic ownership, restricted resource accounts and fenced single-scope migration with uncertain history preserved.
detection: Reveal shared recipient/supplier/purpose during migration; transfer while an effect and deletion scope remain unresolved.
containment: Contain interacting scopes, restore old meaning or reconcile the union, and require accepted successor responsibility before retiring controls.
rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
residual_risk: Interaction discovery and hidden off-platform facts are incomplete; excessive conservatism can defeat useful work.

accountable_owner.actual_assignment: Required at capability/deployment admission; no person or institution appointed by this register

escalation_requirement: Escalate to the migration owner and, where two principals' liabilities or a person's data cross a venture boundary, to C07 and the founder — the principal structure and what may be shared between ventures are the founder's to decide.
design_evidence: planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#10-conflict-scope-and-participant-migrations--t-r1 — the union freeze preserves every unknown hold and potential obligation across the union, and unmapped or ambiguous keys retain a union-wide hold rather than being dropped as obsolete

planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#5-reservations-exact-operation-identity-and-prerequisites — ConflictClaim joins actual recipient population, time window and purpose restrictions for contact across ventures, and a shared supplier joins aggregate capacity and dependent obligations

planning/specification/01-contract-kernel.md#3-normative-types-and-record-envelope — company_id is a coordination namespace and not a legal entity; money, permissions, liabilities and restricted reserves stay separate across principals and cross-company interactions cannot be released by assuming disjointness

planning/specification/03-company-capabilities.md#incidents-knowledge-growth-and-responsible-ending — CAP-32/34 transfer between ventures requires current purpose and recipient authority and compatible meaning; a common owner is not permission to share personal data or infer the same market
implementation_evidence: None. What would discharge it is B02's revocation and conflict-migration races, B05's IC-T10 source, account and provider migration while effects remain unknown, and B09's cross-mechanism failure rehearsals.
revalidation: On every scope or alias migration, whenever a shared recipient, supplier or purpose is discovered across ventures, on any principal restructuring or provider account transfer, and whenever a claimed disjointness is asserted without affirmative evidence.
